name: Additive orthostatic hypotension risk
actions: Use caution when combining agents that can lower standing blood pressure.
Monitor for dizziness, lightheadedness, syncope, falls, and orthostatic blood pressure changes.
Counsel patients to rise slowly from sitting or lying positions.
Use additional caution in older adults, patients with autonomic dysfunction, dehydration, or concurrent antihypertensive therapy.

rationale: Both drugs can contribute to orthostatic blood pressure reduction.
Combined effects may increase dizziness, syncope, and falls risk.
